$comment: Machine-readable Aevea BLE protocol. Generated together with docs/device-protocol.md; keep in sync. DRAFT.

bytes.size: field.size or var (length_field or rest of frame)

assumptions.text: Phone connects directly to Torus and to Link (both have BLE). MagClip has no radio; its data is proxied by Torus.
On Link, BLE terminates on the DWM3001C nRF52833, which relays to the nRF9151 over an internal bus. Inferred from chip list.
Torus-Link peer link (BLE bond + UWB ranging) is Fiddlie-owned firmware and not specified here; only its results are exposed.
Neither Torus nor Link has a display, keypad or button (none in context), so numeric comparison is not possible.
Pairing window opens for 300 s on: first boot, USB-C plug-in (Torus), MagClip latch to Link (Link).
Per-device pairing secret K_pair is injected at factory and also held by the cloud registry.
Bootloader is MCUboot-style: two slots, ECDSA P-256 signature, test boot then confirm, security counter.
Connection profiles follow Apple Accessory Design Guidelines limits; re-check against the current edition.
Thresholds (15% low, 5% critical, 30% DFU min, 300 s away timer, 60 s off-lead loss timer) are starting values.
Event queue holds >= 256 events per device in RAM+flash; drops oldest on overflow.
Bolt force is estimated from slip and drum deceleration; there is no load cell in context. Slip implies ~300 N.
Tether amber threshold is a % of radius (default 80%).
Link enters LTE-M fast paging (1-2 s, ~60 s) when unclipped and it loses both Torus and phone BLE, or when Torus reports tether RED, so a cloud Recall can land.
Device certificate is a compact 146-byte format, not X.509.
Range sample rates: 4 Hz OFF_LEAD, 1 Hz ON_LEAD.
UWB is off ON_LEAD; the line sensor covers distance up to 3 m.
Base UUID AE7E0000-7A1C-4E5A-9D2B-AE7EA0000000 is a placeholder; Aevea must generate a random v4 base once before production and never change it.

manufacturer_data.name: company_id
manufacturer_data.desc: 0xFFFF test ID until Aevea has a SIG company ID.

advertising.address: Resolvable private address after bonding (IRK shared at bonding).

profiles.name: WALK
profiles.phy: 1M; Link may switch to Coded S8

connection.note: Peripheral requests via L2CAP connection parameter update; phone OS may override. Profiles chosen to satisfy Apple Accessory Design Guidelines formulas (A8).

characteristics.name: Battery Level
characteristics.desc: For OS battery widgets. App uses BATTERY event.

characteristics.name: Identity
characteristics.desc: Readable before pairing; used to fetch the passkey from cloud.

characteristics.name: Command
characteristics.desc: Write with response. One command per write.

characteristics.name: Status
characteristics.desc: Notifies on any field change, max 1 Hz.

characteristics.name: Range
characteristics.desc: Live distance: 4 Hz OFF_LEAD, 1 Hz ON_LEAD, off otherwise.

characteristics.name: DFU Control
characteristics.desc: Request: op u8 + payload. Indication: op u8, status u8, payload.

header.name: seq
header.desc: App-chosen sequence, echoed in response. Wraps.

header.name: ev_seq
header.desc: Per-device monotonic event sequence (persists across reboot, wraps at 65535).

header.name: source
header.desc: Device type the event is about (0x03 = MagClip).

header.name: time
header.desc: Unix time, s (from SET_TIME; 0 if never set).

fields.name: last_seen_s
fields.desc: Age of this data at Torus.

fields.name: phone_rssi_dbm
fields.desc: Phone RSSI seen by this device; 127 unknown.

fields.name: line_out_mm
fields.desc: Torus only, from Hall/angle sensor; 0xFFFF n/a.

fields.name: device_id
fields.desc: Registry ID. All zero outside pairing window (privacy).

fields.name: pairing_nonce
fields.desc: Fresh per pairing attempt; input to passkey derivation.

fields.name: signature
fields.desc: ECDSA P-256 r||s by device CA over all prior bytes.

fields.name: signature
fields.desc: ECDSA P-256 by cloud owner-token key over all prior bytes.

owner_token.example_hex: 01 01 23 01 00 00 01 E7 A3 00 7B 7B 7B 7B 7B 7B 7B 7B 7B 7B 7B 7B 7B 7B 7B 7B C0 6F EC 6A 18 72 EC 6A C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3 C3

dfu_image_type.0x01: LINK_CELLULAR_APP (nRF9151 app core, includes nRF7002 firmware)

error_codes.name: OK
error_codes.desc: Success.

error_codes.name: UNKNOWN_OPCODE
error_codes.desc: Opcode not known to this firmware.

error_codes.name: INVALID_LENGTH
error_codes.desc: len does not match the opcode's payload.

error_codes.name: OUT_OF_RANGE
error_codes.desc: A field value is outside its documented range.

error_codes.name: NOT_SUPPORTED
error_codes.desc: Opcode valid but not on this device type or target.

error_codes.name: BUSY
error_codes.desc: Device cannot accept now (flash erase, other op running). Retry after 500 ms.

error_codes.name: INVALID_STATE
error_codes.desc: Not allowed in current state (e.g. STOP_WALK with no walk).

error_codes.name: NOT_AUTHORISED
error_codes.desc: Owner not bound, or command needs owner binding.

error_codes.name: TARGET_UNREACHABLE
error_codes.desc: MagClip not currently reachable through Torus.

error_codes.name: LOW_BATTERY
error_codes.desc: Refused to protect battery (e.g. DFU below 30% not charging).

error_codes.name: VERSION_MISMATCH
error_codes.desc: Frame ver (protocol major) not supported.

error_codes.name: STORAGE_FULL
error_codes.desc: No slot left (bonds, home Wi-Fi slots, peers).

error_codes.name: TIMEOUT
error_codes.desc: Internal operation timed out (e.g. GNSS no fix).

error_codes.name: AUTH_FAILED
error_codes.desc: Signature or token check failed.

error_codes.name: DFU_INVALID_SIGNATURE
error_codes.desc: Image signature does not verify against the boot key.

error_codes.name: DFU_INVALID_IMAGE
error_codes.desc: Header/type/size wrong for this device.

error_codes.name: DFU_OFFSET_MISMATCH
error_codes.desc: Data offset not equal to expected offset.

error_codes.name: DFU_HASH_MISMATCH
error_codes.desc: SHA-256 of received image differs from DFU_START.

error_codes.name: DFU_DOWNGRADE_REJECTED
error_codes.desc: Security counter lower than running image.

error_codes.name: DFU_NOT_STARTED
error_codes.desc: DFU op sent before DFU_START.

error_codes.name: INTERNAL
error_codes.desc: Unexpected firmware error; detail in FAULT event.

commands.name: GET_INFO
commands.desc: Versions and capabilities. Always sent first after connect.

commands.name: SET_TIME
commands.desc: Sets device clock for event timestamps.

commands.name: GET_STATUS
commands.desc: Returns status struct (magclip_status when target=MagClip).

commands.name: GET_EVENTS
commands.desc: Replays queued events on the Event characteristic.

commands.name: ACK_EVENTS
commands.desc: Frees queued events.

commands.name: SELF_TEST
commands.desc: Runs self test; result in SELF_TEST_RESULT event.

commands.name: FACTORY_RESET
commands.desc: Erases bonds, owner, peers, Wi-Fi slots, event queue. Keeps factory keys.

commands.name: START_WALK
commands.desc: Starts a walk. Sent to both Torus and Link.

queue.coalesce: STOP_WALK with same walk_id cancels a queued START_WALK

commands.name: STOP_WALK
commands.desc: Stops walk, returns walk summary.

commands.name: SET_TETHER
commands.desc: Configures off-lead tether. Torus is authoritative; Link mirrors for local alerts.

commands.name: SET_HALO
commands.desc: Overrides Halo. AUTO_STATE returns control to firmware.

commands.name: BUZZ
commands.desc: One-shot haptic/sound cue.

request.name: actuator
request.desc: Torus: LRA only. Link: LRA and/or piezo.

request.name: pattern
request.desc: Aevea pattern ID 1-16 (mapped to DRV2605L effects in firmware).

commands.name: RECALL_ASSIST
commands.desc: Plays recall cue on Link.

queue.note: Never queued. If BLE write fails within 2 s, app sends via cloud.

commands.name: LOCATE_NOW
commands.desc: Requests GNSS fix; result in LOCATION event.

queue.note: If not connected, app uses cloud path.

commands.name: LOST_MODE
commands.desc: Enters/leaves Lost Mode.

request.name: interval_s
request.desc: Base report interval; firmware slows as battery falls.

queue.note: Cloud is authoritative; BLE copy sent too when connected.

commands.name: SET_HOME_WIFI
commands.desc: Stores a home SSID for scan-only home detection.

commands.name: BIND_PEER
commands.desc: Binds Torus and Link to each other; key for peer BLE bond and UWB STS derivation.

request.name: peer_pubkey
request.desc: Peer P-256 public key X||Y (from peer cert, checked by app and cloud).

commands.name: UNBIND_PEER
commands.desc: Removes peer.

commands.name: GET_CERT
commands.desc: Reads device certificate in chunks.

commands.name: AUTH_CHALLENGE
commands.desc: Proves device holds its factory identity key.

response.name: signature
response.desc: ECDSA P-256 by device identity key over SHA-256('AEVEA-AUTH'||app_nonce||device_nonce||device_id).

events.name: BATTERY
events.desc: On 5% step, charge state change, or threshold crossing.

events.name: STATE_CHANGED
events.desc: Any activity or power state change.

fields.name: sensed_by
fields.desc: Device that saw the contact change.

events.name: BOLT
events.desc: Bolt/slip event detected by line Hall/angle sensors.

events.name: TETHER
events.desc: On level change only (continuous values on Range).

events.name: LOCATION
events.desc: Locate now result or Lost Mode fix (when BLE connected).

events.name: LOST_MODE_STATUS
events.desc: Lost Mode entered/left or interval changed.

fields.name: module
fields.desc: self_test bit index of failing block.

response.name: resume_offset
response.desc: Non-zero if same sha256 partially received.

response.name: max_chunk
response.desc: Max data bytes per DFU_DATA write.

transitions.trigger: START_WALK, or MAGCLIP latched with peer linked
STOP_WALK, or home Wi-Fi seen and no motion 10 min
Peer (Torus) AND phone BLE lost for 60 s
Home Wi-Fi not seen AND peer not seen AND phone not seen for 300 s, motion detected
Home Wi-Fi seen, or peer/phone regained
LOST_MODE on (BLE or cloud). Never automatic.
Charger detected (USB-C, dock or MagClip contacts)

ON_LEAD.uwb: off (line sensor gives distance up to 3 m)

OFF_LEAD_TETHER.ble: WALK conn + peer link, Coded PHY ready
OFF_LEAD_TETHER.lte_m: eDRX; fast paging window on Recall fallback

MAGCLIP.note: No radio in context. Passive except contact sensing and charging. Lock is mechanical.

offline_queue.replay: GET_EVENTS from last ACKed ev_seq+1, then ACK_EVENTS

START_WALK.coalesce: STOP_WALK with same walk_id cancels a queued START_WALK

RECALL_ASSIST.note: Never queued. If BLE write fails within 2 s, app sends via cloud.

LOCATE_NOW.note: If not connected, app uses cloud path.

LOST_MODE.note: Cloud is authoritative; BLE copy sent too when connected.

open_questions: Does Torus or Link have any button, touch area or capacitive input? It would enable numeric comparison and a manual pairing window.
How does Torus reach MagClip while the clip is on the collar (conductors in the line, relay via Link, or only when docked)? Who senses latch: MagClip MCU, Link, or both?
Does MagClip have an MCU with updatable firmware? If yes, how is it updated through Torus?
Key storage on nRF52833 (no CryptoCell/KMU): is a secure element planned, or protected flash + APPROTECT? Same question for the DWM3001C inside Link.
UWB secure ranging: which STS mode (FiRa SP3 static/dynamic STS?) and how should the STS key be derived from the BIND_PEER ECDH secret?
Which side is UWB initiator/controller, and what ranging rate is affordable within the 7+ day (Link) and 9-13 day (Torus) battery targets?
Bootloader choice: MCUboot + MCUmgr/SMP (which would replace the Aevea DFU service) or custom? Signature algorithm and key ceremony?
Is nRF9151 modem firmware update over BLE in scope, or only over LTE-M (FOTA)? Expected image sizes for each image type?
Recall Assist fallback trigger: what exactly wakes LTE-M fast paging (A13)? Is 1-2 s paging achievable with the chosen network/eDRX settings?
Coded PHY: confirm phone-side support (iOS exposure is uncertain) and Link TX power; else Recall falls back to 1M + cloud.
Can Torus derive a usable force estimate from Hall/angle data (A11), and what accuracy should the app show?
Flash budget for event queue (A10), dual-slot images and bonds on each MCU.
Does Torus need its own clock source or is SET_TIME on connect enough for event timestamps?
Bluetooth SIG company ID and Bluetooth qualification (QDID) plan; EN 18031 and PSTI requirements on default passwords/pairing.
